messages:
sarah: Quick async: prepping the canary/demo flow for the new routing + fallback work. What I did: wrote the rollout playbook draft and synced with sales on demo expectations. Blockers: need a staged canary and autoscaler knob confirmed.

mike: I pushed a change to retry/backoff behavior in the API layer. Not blocking for the demo, but it changes how we surface errors on 429s. @sarah can you OK or revert?

raj: Infra: I can carve out a 3x A100 pool for canary. Staging deploy doable tomorrow morning. Prod after smoke tests and autoscaler offload patch merged (target in 3 days).

olivia: QA plan: will run full regression once staging is up, plus targeted perf runs simulating bursty sessions. Need final prompt/test set from product (edge cases) to add to eval harness.

jess: UX: adjusted onboarding modal per legal. Minor spacing tweak for mobile. Pushed screenshot to the spec PR.

sarah: Edge cases to add to eval harness:
```
- long multi-turn with nested code blocks (~2k tokens): ensure important tail context preserved
- many small rapid requests from same session (5-10 rps): ensure batching doesn't increase p95
```
Please add, @olivia.

mike: I'll open infra PR for route header-based canary and fallback snippet:
```
- match: header(x-experiment) == "canary"
  target: canary-pool
  fallback: default-pool
```

raj: When we stage, I'll set NLB drain to 45s and temporarily disable aggressive autoscaling to avoid p95 spikes.

olivia: ETA for test coverage additions: tomorrow AM. Will flag any failures here. Also will run smoke checklist: onboarding modal, API latency under batching, eval results for edge prompts.

sarah: Timeline: mike merges feature after approvals, raj stages, olivia runs tests, jess finalizes copy, I'll confirm demo slot with sales for Thursday. If anyone can't meet these, flag now.

mike: CI green except one flaky test I fixed in PR 487. Requesting fast review on retry/backoff change.

sarah: Approved the retry change after reviewing. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued — staging/product-canary build 425 starting in 2m.

raj: Deploy started. I'll paste smoke test checklist when done.

olivia: Smoke tests running. Early results: latency under batch is within SLO; small redis glitch in step 2, restarted worker and retried, no user-facing errors.

mike: Opened infra PR for canary route, will add tests in infra-shared.

olivia: Regression run mostly green; filing issue for flaky embedding test (#922).

sarah: Demo confirmed with sales for Thursday afternoon. I'll share the demo script and invite link. Thanks all, keep posting updates here if anything changes. :rocket:
